why: In section 6 the reader says they wanted, and couldn't find, "a clear line saying how much I put in in total (70,000 ₪), so I can see how much is profit." That names the missing amount paid in, the reference point for judging the headline result. In section 1 they work out the 70,000 themselves but don't complain about it there. Counted in order, this comes after about 17 earlier problems: young-people prices, Psagot, the inflation button, what a "pair" means, the tax framing, fund tags, the step chart's starting point, the repeated tables, the bar colours, −0.04%, today's money, 4A/40, the fee types, custody fees, the open tax rule, the standing order, and step-by-step instructions.
